summary: Verified legacy platform Google Sign-in integration end-to-end (contract + dual-auth + UI + regressions). Backend: 55/56 tests pass (the 1 failure is the pre-existing TestEquipment.test_list_seeded SB-001 vs SB-2001 mismatch, explicitly ignored per review). New file /app/backend/tests/test_google_session_auth.py (9 tests, 9/9 pass) covers: (1) POST /api/auth/session with bogus session_id → 401; (2) sending session_token instead of session_id → 422 (Pydantic rejects — the endpoint accepts ONLY {session_id}); (3) empty body → 422; (4) extra/other fields → 422; (5) get_current_user accepts a synthetic user_sessions row via Bearer → GET /api/auth/me returns the admin user (SESSION-TOKEN path); (6) GET /api/auth/me with JWT still works (JWT regression); (7) an expired synthetic session_token is rejected → 401; (8) missing bearer → 401; (9) MongoDB indexes exist as required: users.email unique, equipment.sku unique, user_sessions.session_token unique, user_sessions.user_id, user_sessions.expires_at with expireAfterSeconds=0 (TTL). Existing JWT flow regressions all green: /api/auth/login, /auth/me, /auth/refresh, register RBAC, account lockout, equipment CRUD+CSV, rentals lifecycle+PUT+PATCH location, bookings+capacity, maintenance, vendors, site, bracing, geocode, dashboard/stats. /api/register-push and root/health probes suite (8/8) also green. Frontend (mobile 390x844 at https://icfops.srv1427612.hstgr.cloud): login screen renders 'Continue with Google' button (testID google-signin-button) at y=307 ABOVE email input at y=435 with a visible 'OR SIGN IN WITH EMAIL' divider between them; the demo credentials hint box has been removed (no 'admin@concreteform.com', 'ChangeMe', or 'demo' text on the login screen). Clicking the Google button triggers window.location redirect to https://retired-auth-provider.invalid/?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Ficfops.srv1427612.hstgr.cloud%2F — confirmed via request interception and final URL ending up on accounts.google.com (legacy platform's OAuth relay works). Email/password login still succeeds via testIDs login-email-input / login-password-input / login-submit-button — admin@concreteform.com / [REDACTED-ROTATE-CREDENTIAL] → Dashboard (Welcome Admin, Utilization 2.3%, Active Rentals 1, Vendors 1). No red screen; the only console noise is pre-existing (expo-notifications-on-web deprecation warnings and react-native props.pointerEvents deprecation) — not related to Google sign-in. The 'API key not found' pageerror observed during the click test came from Google's own accounts page after redirect, NOT from our app code path.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:239-241 — SessionExchangeBody has ONLY {session_id: str}; Pydantic enforces 422 on any other field name, satisfying the 'must NEVER accept session_token' requirement. Verified.

server.py:512-571 — /api/auth/session correctly (a) calls legacy platform oauth/session-data with X-Session-ID header, (b) 401s on non-200 upstream (verified with bogus id), (c) upserts user by email and REUSES existing id/role for the JWT admin — this is the requested cross-auth continuity, (d) writes a user_sessions row with session_token + expires_at (+7d) + user_id + provider='legacy-platform_google', (e) uses idempotent upsert on session_token so replay of the same session_id is safe.

server.py:368-407 — get_current_user checks the session_token path FIRST, JWT SECOND. Verified with a synthetic user_sessions insert that GET /api/auth/me works with Bearer <session_token>. Expiry check handles both tz-aware and naive datetimes.

server.py:1096-1104 — on_startup creates all required indexes: users.email unique, equipment.sku unique, user_sessions.session_token unique, user_sessions.user_id, user_sessions.expires_at TTL (expireAfterSeconds=0). Verified via db.<coll>.index_information().
AuthContext.tsx:33-42 — extractSessionId + web hash/search parsing + cleanup follows the playbook exactly (Rule #3: process URL BEFORE anything else, then strip session_id from history).

AuthContext.tsx:155-188 — loginWithGoogle on web sets window.location.href (verified redirect); mobile branch uses openAuthSessionAsync + Linking listener + getInitialURL fallback (Android relaunch guard) — matches the playbook triple-fallback.
login.tsx:64-81 — Google button ABOVE the divider ABOVE the email/password inputs. testID='google-signin-button'. Divider text 'or sign in with email' present. Demo hint box removed.
